top_categories.workout_context: Road-specific control matters at L'Étape Marmaris by Tour de France. Practice on mountain roads above the Marmaris coast: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 60 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic L'Étape Marmaris by Tour de France's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.

103ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at L'Étape Marmaris by Tour de France. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
At L'Étape Marmaris by Tour de France, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
60 miles on mountain roads above the Marmaris coast burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for L'Étape Marmaris by Tour de France's 60 miles. Start early, use products you tolerate, and carry enough between the organizer’s confirmed resupply points.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at L'Étape Marmaris by Tour de France. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The technical descents at L'Étape Marmaris by Tour de France demand practice on similar paved roads. Ride mountain roads above the marmaris coast at race-day cadence weekly. Practice braking points, corner entry, line choice, and accelerating smoothly out of turns. Confirm tire pressure and equipment before race week.
